lines.en: : But Jesus refused — for he and his apostles had only just begun the first ever Nodokathon...and there were still more games to be played.
lines.zh: : 但耶稣拒绝了——因为他与他的使徒们才刚刚开始史上第一届 Nodokathon……还有更多的比赛要玩呢。

lines.en: scene thefootjobone40
: But before they could begin, a choice needed to be made. Just as a choice needs to be made now.
lines.zh: : 但在那之前，必须先做出一个选择。正如现在也需要做出一个选择一样。

lines.en: : Something, something, who gave the better footjob?
lines.zh: : 什么什么的，谁的足交更厉害来着？

lines.en: I sigh to myself and place a metaphorical crown of thorns on the winner’s head that I imagine will cut their opponent even deeper.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，把一顶隐喻的荆冠戴到赢家头上——我想，这顶冠冕会把她的对手刺得更深。

lines.en: menu:
Miku
lines.zh: Miku

lines.en: : The winner of this contest...is Miku.
lines.zh: : 这场比赛的赢家……是 Miku。

lines.en: scene thefootjobone41
: Frick yeah! I knew I was gonna redeem myself tonight! I’m changin’ my nickname to the Champion of Justice and Footjobs!
lines.zh: : 靠，太爽了！我就知道今晚能一雪前耻！我要把我的外号改成「正义与足交的冠军」！

lines.en: : Did I go a little overboard with the dialogue?
lines.zh: : 我刚才的台词是不是有点过了？

lines.en: : No. That was...quite enjoyable, weirdly enough. But Miku did something you did not.
lines.zh: : 没有。说起来怪得很，那还……挺享受的。不过 Miku 做了一件你没做的事。

lines.en: : I masturbated! And I regret nothing because it felt great!
lines.zh: : 我自慰了！而且我一点都不后悔，因为太爽了！

lines.en: : Bingo.
lines.zh: : 答对了。

lines.en: : Also, I think she’s just better with her feet. And that {i}was{/i} the point of the contest, so...
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得她脚上的功夫就是更胜一筹。而那{i}正是{/i}这场比赛的要点，所以……

lines.en: scene thefootjobone42
: You could have left that point out, but...I suppose I admit defeat.
lines.zh: : 那点您本来可以不提的，不过……我就认输吧。

lines.en: : Thanks for the match, Miku. You were as worthy an adversary as always.
lines.zh: : 打得不错，Miku。你跟往常一样是个值得尊敬的对手。

lines.en: : Couldn’t’a done it without Sensei!
lines.zh: : 没有老师我可做不到！

lines.en: : Now please excuse me while I find that Jesus guy and his water thing. And don’t make fun’a me for hoppin’ around until my foot’s clean!
lines.zh: : 那么失陪了，我得去找那个 Jesus 和他的水之类的东西。还有，不准笑我单脚蹦着走，直到我的脚干净为止！

lines.en: $ dormwars5floor1points += 1

Kirin
lines.zh: Kirin

lines.en: : The winner of this contest...is Kirin.
lines.zh: : 这场比赛的赢家……是 Kirin。

lines.en: scene thefootjobone43
: Frick.
: Really?! So you {i}do{/i} like being insulted like that and it didn’t sound weird?! Cause I’ve been wanting to try that for a while and-
lines.zh: : 真的？！所以你{i}真的{/i}喜欢被那样骂，而且听起来不奇怪？！因为我早就想试试了——

lines.en: : It was quite enjoyable. But I was mostly surprised about how you- wait, why have you wanted to try that for a while?
lines.zh: : 相当享受。不过最让我意外的是你——等等，你为什么早就想试试了？

lines.en: scene thefootjobone44
: Because I’m a bad girl. Looks like I need to be punished now. Oh well!
lines.zh: : 因为我是个坏女孩。看来现在得受罚了。算了！

lines.en: : Mark my words, Sensei. This ain’t the last you’ve felt of Miku Maruyama’s feet.
lines.zh: : 记住我的话，老师。这绝不是您最后一次感受到 Miku Maruyama 的脚。

lines.en: : Least I felt like I had a shot in this contest, unlike the friggin’ trivia one.
lines.zh: : 至少我觉得这次比赛我有机会赢，不像那该死的常识问答。

lines.en: : Yeah. I think I enjoyed this contest a lot more thoroughly too. And I also...may have learned something about myself thanks to Kirin.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我觉得这场比赛我也享受得彻底多了。而且我……可能还多亏 Kirin 认识到了自己的一面。

lines.en: : Nice to finally turn the tables since I’ve learned plenty of things about myself from you! Particularly how hot I find age gaps now. So thanks, I guess!
lines.zh: : 总算轮到我反将一军了，毕竟我从你那儿也认识了不少自己的事！尤其是我现在觉得年龄差有多带感。所以谢了，大概！

lines.en: : Yeah...you’re welcome, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不客气，大概。
